segments.name: Software solutions
segments.description: Provides subscription access to the Group's software platforms and white-label software rights to customers.
segments.evidence: Revenue in this segment primarily comprises continuous right-to-access subscriptions to the Group's software platforms and the sale of non-exclusive rights to use white-label versions of the Group's software.

segments.name: Advisory
segments.description: Provides advisory engagements delivered as specific deliverables, customized IT solutions or project milestones to clients.
segments.evidence: Where advisory engagements are structured around specific deliverables, customized IT solutions, or project milestones, each deliverable or milestone represents a distinct performance obligation.

segments.name: Data
segments.description: Provides ESG data solutions and the Matter Analytics Platform on subscription for continuous access.
segments.evidence: Data service revenue is generated through subscriptions to the Group's ESG data solutions or the Matter Analytics Platform.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for software platform subscriptions, data subscriptions, and advisory deliverables or milestones.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue in this segment primarily comprises continuous right-to-access subscriptions to the Group's software platforms and the sale of non-exclusive rights to use white-label versions of the Group's software.
